limitations.effect: The capsule's literal model/configuration cannot be claimed as observed.
limitations.limitation: Cursor run identity exposes originalModelName gpt-5.6-sol-max-fast, while the capsule requests gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh with xhigh reasoning. A separate reasoning-control value is not exposed.
limitations.treatment: Record the observed model and reasoning control as NOT_SUPPORTED; do not relabel max-fast as xhigh.

limitations.effect: BHC-01 establishes that the implementation pattern admits write loss, not that current LangGraph loses writes in a production graph or at any measured rate.
limitations.limitation: The checkpoint reproduction is an independently written sanitized collector with a controlled stale-snapshot schedule. It does not install LangGraph or exercise its BackgroundExecutor call graph.
limitations.treatment: Keep the LangGraph mechanism disposition at RETEST until an end-to-end pinned-version reproduction and maintainer disposition exist.

limitations.effect: No provider-specific result-loss frequency or causal conclusion follows from BHC-02.
limitations.limitation: The process-exit fixture approximates ephemeral agent custody locally. It does not kill a Cursor Cloud Agent, run a GitHub-hosted runner, or inject a real network/push failure.
limitations.treatment: Use the fixture only to test the custody invariant that completion without durable hash read-back is insufficient.

limitations.effect: The paper supports recurrence taxonomy but its reported frequencies and labels remain secondary evidence here.
limitations.limitation: MAST-Data, its annotator, and the seven source frameworks were not downloaded or rerun. The paper is arXiv v3 and was not independently replicated in this unit.
limitations.treatment: Do not transfer MAST rates to PO-03; cite only the published trace count and named failure modes.

limitations.effect: The current incident source cannot support a result-loss mechanism.
limitations.limitation: Cursor's 2026-08-18 incident report records Cloud Agent workflow failures but gives no root cause, custody state, or evidence that completed results were lost.
limitations.treatment: Retain it as a current negative-boundary source and exclude it from causal support.

limitations.effect: Issue and proposed-fix claims have lower evidentiary weight than merged code or maintainer-confirmed reports.
limitations.limitation: LangGraph issue #8115 is open and external; PR #8114 is closed unmerged, and its buggy-path test contains a vacuous non-negative assertion.
limitations.treatment: Distinguish direct current-code observation from reporter causality claims and proposed-fix claims.

limitations.effect: Mutable pages may later differ despite the recorded retrieval digest.
limitations.limitation: Web and API representations were not copied into the repository because rights and scope favor proposition-level cards. Commit-pinned repository sources are immutable; vendor pages and status APIs are not.
limitations.treatment: Record access dates, representation hashes/bytes, source commits where available, and short validity horizons.

limitations.effect: This unit is a producer result only.
limitations.limitation: No independent evaluator has accepted the artifacts, and no live shared PO-03 mechanism was changed under this subordinate's narrow path ownership.
limitations.treatment: Return READY_TO_COMMIT only after commit, push, and immutable local/remote read-back; never claim Obzio COMPLETED or ACCEPTED.
